title: Corpus licence block
description: The licence block of a corpus manifest, corpus.json "licence": format popboll.licence/1 (block version 1). It says what the rights holder allowed. A reader that finds a scope it does not know, a version newer than it understands, or a revoked_at or expires_at in the past must treat every capability as off. A capability that is left out takes its scope's default: full turns all eight on; morpus_only turns store_audio, stream_audio, store_art and export_morpus off; public_domain_midi turns transcode, store_audio, stream_audio and store_art off. Members this schema does not name are allowed and must be kept by writers.

schema.description: The format name. Writers always write it; a reader accepts a block without it.

version.description: The block version. A reader closes every capability on a version it does not know.

scope.description: What kind of grant this is.

transcode.description: Pop Boll may run the recordings through its transcriber.

stream_audio.description: The recordings may be played to listeners. Needs store_audio.

stream_render.description: The corpus's MIDI may be played to listeners rendered through Pop Boll's own sounds (never a recording). On by default for public_domain_midi, off for full and morpus_only unless the artist grants it.

store_art.description: Cover art may be kept and shown.

store_morpus.description: The derived MIDI and notes may be kept.

musicians_may_study.description: The virtual musicians may learn from the morpus. Needs store_morpus.

export_morpus.description: People, not only Pop Boll's engines, may download the morpus. Needs store_morpus.

device_copies.description: What may be stored may also be copied onto Pop Boll devices.

expires_at.description: When the grant lapses. From then on every capability is off.

revoked_at.description: When the grant was withdrawn. From then on every capability is off.

audio_destroyed_at.description: When the source recordings were last destroyed (morpus_only).

granted_by.description: Who made the grant: free-form members such as legal_name, band, email.

statements.description: The affirmations the rights holder agreed to, in the order shown.

statements_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the statements: for each one, in order, the UTF-8 bytes of key, a NUL byte, text and a newline. Hex, lower case.

shake_version.description: The version of the artist agreement the statements come from. Absent means 1.

hosting.description: Where the recordings live: sent to Pop Boll, or hosted by the artist.

grants.description: Every consent, oldest first. Append only.

sources.description: One row per upload whose recordings were destroyed.

allOf.$comment: Hard limits: these two scopes never keep or play recordings.
stream_audio needs store_audio. Under full both default to on, so switching store_audio off means writing stream_audio off too.
musicians_may_study needs store_morpus, and defaults to on in every scope.
export_morpus needs store_morpus, and defaults to on in these two scopes.
export_morpus needs store_morpus; under morpus_only it defaults to off already.

time.description: A UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with optional fraction and optional Z, or a date alone (read as midnight UTC). No UTC offsets.
